name: Magic Patterns
description: Magic Patterns lets agents create and read UI designs and prototypes in the signed-in Magic Patterns account. Each user signs in to their own Magic Patterns account through the browser.

prompts.text: Design a settings page for a project management app.
Make the onboarding design simpler and use fewer steps.
Get the code of my latest design so I can add it to the app.

apps.name: Magic Patterns
apps.description: UI design and prototype generation, over Magic Patterns' MCP server with browser sign-in.
